name: Vignette the Seal-Point Cat
description: Vignette, a cream seal-point cat with a dark brown mask, ears, paws and tail, gazes from the porch step with wide sky-blue eyes and a slow blink. A cat coin priced in AMBA. Not affiliated with Ambarella, Backpack Securities or StonkFun. No intrinsic value; not financial advice.
look: A normal four-legged cream cat with seal-point colouring: a dark brown mask, ears, paws and tail, and wide sky-blue eyes. It is based on camera image processing, where a vignette is the darker edge around a bright picture, like dark points around a pale coat. It wears nothing.
